title: A code item the orchestrator works in its own session lands through backlog.py land
goal: The kb-sprint run step that lets the orchestrator do a narrow item in its own session names how a code-lane item done there lands: backlog.py land accepts the item's commits on the orchestrator's branch (or the step says to commit on a work/<id> branch first), so land waits for its code/<id> merge request and runs done and the push, with no hand poll of origin/main. Answers the SP-ktup3cha retrospective: ST-atorqkvw was committed on orch/mac, pushed as code/ST-atorqkvw by sync, and its merge was polled by hand before done.

run: import sys; t=open('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read(); ok='in its own session lands' in t; print(ok); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
